summary: Iteration 7 regression testing of the code-review fix batch (md5->sha256 session ids, env-based demo credentials, _build_comparison difference default, ViralityScore composite keys). BACKEND: full existing suite re-run = 66/66 PASSED, plus a new targeted suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_fixes.py = 15/15 PASSED (81/81 total, 100%). Confirmed: (1) POST /api/auth/demo still returns access_token with user.email=demo@launchloop.ai and is_demo=true; password login demo@launchloop.ai/demo1234 still works; wrong password rejected; seeded demo data intact (2 audiences, >=3 campaigns) after the env-var refactor of seed.py. (2) Generation caching UNCHANGED after sha256 switch — identical second POST /api/generate returns cached=true with byte-identical headlines and 4 angles each carrying all 5 factors. (3) /api/deep-analysis returns non-empty comparison.agreement AND comparison.difference across 4 edge cases (normal, empty headline+body, 1-char headline, keyword-dense LinkedIn copy) and 5 factor_diffs; /api/campaigns/{id}/deep-analysis persists and public /api/report/{id} exposes deep_analysis.comparison.difference. (4) Learning-note sign consistency verified programmatically over synthetic outcome, impressions-crash override, impressions-spike override, mixed override and resynth — the note always uses the matching clause ('beat the forecast' / 'fell short of the forecast' / 'tracked the forecast closely') for the signed delta.impressions.pct, with the magnitude matching within 1pp; values persist on GET. FRONTEND SMOKE (Chromium 1920x1080, dark + light): landing -> hero-demo instant demo login -> Dashboard (demo-badge 'Demo · synthetic data') -> Create Launch wizard (product -> audience-select -> goal-awareness -> platforms pre-selected -> auto-generation) -> 4 angle cards with scores -> re-select 3rd angle rescoring correctly (61/C) -> all 5 virality factors expand and render reason <li> items (composite keys, no React key warnings) -> Run Deep Analysis on wizard AND experiment detail (both show AGREEMENT + DIFFERENCE + 5 factor pairs + AI reasons) -> Angle Rewrite factor chips -> Run Launch -> Experiment Detail (prediction-vs-reality grid, verdict badge, learning-note) -> save real metrics (800/700/600/500) flips verdict to UNDERPERFORMED and the note correctly reads 'Impressions fell short of the forecast by 96%' for -96.5%; persisted across reload -> Share Report (/report/{id}) renders score, factor explanations, prediction/reality and the persisted deep analysis -> Leaderboard scope toggle (global 19 rows / mine 9 / back to global 19) -> Analytics (all 4 stats + 4 charts + best-angle/best-platform + top-angles) -> Audience DNA (cards/edit/delete/use testids) -> How to use (/app/help). Theme: theme-light/theme-dark/theme-system persist to localStorage ll_theme and survive reload/navigation. team-watermark 'TAS INNOVATORS' present with pointer-events:none (non-blocking). ZERO console errors or warnings across every page visited.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _build_comparison: the `difference` default is now correctly assigned before the conditionals, so the biggest['diff'] == 0 path returns 'AI and the heuristic are closely aligned on every factor.' instead of an unbound name. Verified by the empty-headline/empty-body case. No further change needed.

llm_service.py: md5 -> sha256 only affects the Gemini session_id label (session_id=f"launchloop-{sha256[:8]}") — _cache_key was already sha256, so the angle_cache key space is unchanged and existing cached rows keep hitting. Confirmed cached=true on repeat generate.

seed.py: DEMO_EMAIL/DEMO_PASSWORD read from env with fallbacks is safe here because the seeded user lookup is by DEMO_EMAIL. Note the residual (pre-existing, low) risk: if DEMO_PASSWORD is later changed in env, seed_all will NOT re-hash the password for the already-existing demo user (the else-branch only reads user['id']). Consider updating password_hash when it no longer verifies, mirroring the seed_admin idempotency pattern.

virality.py learning_note is sign-correct, but the `mid` clause can still read 'Conversions beat expectations' inside an overall UNDERPERFORMED note (observed: conversions +85.9% while impressions -96.5%). This is factually accurate per-metric, so it is informational only, not a defect.

Playbook items 2-5 from the testing instructions (httpOnly cookies, CORS allow-credentials with explicit origins, 5-attempt brute-force lockout, seed_admin password refresh) are NOT implemented in this app — it uses localStorage + JWT Bearer by design, and the request explicitly scoped the httpOnly-cookie auth rewrite as skipped. Only item 1 was verified: bcrypt hashes start with $2b$ (tests/backend_test.py::test_bcrypt_hash_format PASSED). Flagging so it is not mistaken for a regression.

rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. The three previously reported iteration-6 items were re-checked: the learning-note sign contradiction is FIXED (virality.learning_note now branches on the signed imp_pct with >=5 / <=-5 / else thresholds and prints abs() only inside the 'fell short' wording); comparison.difference is always populated; ViralityScore reason keys are composite (`${f.key}-${j}`) so no duplicate-key warnings appear in console.
